top1.title: 【2026-10-26】非テック企業のAI投資に利益効果は見えず、アポロのエコノミストが分析
top1.lead1: アポロの首席エコノミストが、主要テック7社を除くS&P500企業の業績から、AI投資の財務効果に疑問を呈しました。
top1.lead2: 利益率や従業員当たり売上高は横ばいとの分析です。AI全般の無効性を証明したものではなく、非テック企業の収益化への問題提起です。

top10.title: [2026-10-26] No apparent profit gains from AI investment at non-tech companies, Apollo economist finds
top10.summary: Apollo's chief economist noted that profit margins and revenue per employee were flat at S&P 500 companies excluding the seven major tech firms. The analysis expressed skepticism about AI's financial impact.

top10.title: [2026-10-26] Grok releases seven minutes of AI-generated 'The Odyssey'; TechCrunch reviews it
top10.summary: Grok released the first episode of its 'The Odyssey' series, created with Grok Imagine. A TechCrunch review acknowledged the photorealism of some footage while sharply criticizing the storytelling and direction.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
